title: Advocate Jatin Sharma Examines Emerging Legal Questions as Businesses Adopt AI
description: New Delhi [India], October 23: The adoption of artificial intelligence and digital platforms is changing how organisations manage information, deliver services and work with customers. Alongside operational opportunities, these changes are prompting businesses to examine questions around data use, intellectual property, confidentiality and responsibility under commercial agreements. Advocate Jatin Sharma, Founder and Managing Counsel of Jurist & Jurist International and National Chairman – Legal Services Committee (India) of the Asian-African Chamber of Commerce and Industry (AACCI), works across legal areas that intersect with these commercial and technology-related issues.
